responsibility: Implements the AArch64 target’s common option-layer hooks used outside the main backend proper: it defines optimization defaults, parses and records target command-line options such as -march, -mcpu, -mtune, alignment and erratum flags into gcc_options, maintains AArch64 ISA feature-bit state for assembler and compiler use, and provides the driver-side logic that rewrites -mcpu selections into canonical assembler-facing architecture strings with explicit extension enable/disable suffixes derived from the target’s feature-dependency tables.
